svg.title: Two frozen holdout shapes: primary area ratios and fixed-threshold range
svg.desc: All 36 color/pose rows. Dot is predeclared threshold 8, line spans thresholds 4,8,16,24. It is not a confidence interval or an acceptance score.

g.text: Frozen holdouts: observed color-evidence area ratios
Dot = frozen primary T8; whisker = range over fixed T4 / 8 / 16 / 24.
Threshold range is not a confidence interval. Ratio 1 does not imply matching support, position or components.
Android evidence area / native evidence area; each original color and pose is kept separate.
